kinds.label: Organisation
kinds.note: The organisations you picked when connecting Xero; to add one, connect again and pick it. Access to all organisations covers ones added later. Drafts are never sent or approved: a person approves them in Xero.

operations.name: list_organisations
operations.title: List organisations
operations.description: List the Xero organisations you may read.

operations.name: search_contacts
operations.title: Search contacts
operations.description: Find customers and suppliers in a Xero organisation, by name, contact number or email address, sorted by name. Balances are Xero's totals and name no currency; for amounts in one currency, search the contact's invoices. Bank details are left out. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: search_invoices
operations.title: Search invoices and bills
operations.description: Find sales invoices and bills in a Xero organisation by type, status, contact, date and text in the number or reference, newest first. Amounts are decimal strings in the invoice's currency. To get the next page, repeat the call with identical arguments plus the returned next_cursor.

operations.name: get_invoice
operations.title: Read an invoice or bill
operations.description: Read one sales invoice or bill in a Xero organisation: its totals, up to 200 lines and up to 50 payments. Amounts are decimal strings in the invoice's currency.

operations.name: list_accounts
operations.title: List accounts
operations.description: List the active accounts in a Xero organisation's chart of accounts, with their codes and default tax types, for the lines of draft invoices and bills. Bank account numbers are left out.

operations.name: list_tax_rates
operations.title: List tax rates
operations.description: List the active tax rates in a Xero organisation, as percentages, for the lines of draft invoices and bills. tax_type is the value lines take.

operations.name: create_draft_invoice
operations.title: Create a draft sales invoice
operations.description: Create a draft sales invoice to a customer in a Xero organisation where you may draft sales invoices. Lines take an account code and tax type from list_accounts and list_tax_rates, or the defaults of their item, contact or organisation. Xero neither sends drafts nor posts them to the accounts; a person reviews and approves them in Xero. A draft is not deduplicated across runs.

operations.name: create_draft_bill
operations.title: Create a draft bill
operations.description: Create a draft bill from a supplier in a Xero organisation where you may draft bills. Lines take an account code and tax type from list_accounts and list_tax_rates, or the defaults of their item, contact or organisation. Xero neither sends drafts nor posts them to the accounts; a person reviews and approves them in Xero. A draft is not deduplicated across runs.
